source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the temperate deciduous forest, printed page 241.

blocks.text: Yeh jangalat nam (moist) pahari ilaqon mein milte hain jahan mausam wazeh taur par badalte hain, aur in mein ek thandi sardi bhi aati hai jis mein darakht apne patte gira dete hain (deciduous, yaani patjhar wale).

items: Location (jagah): Shimali ilaqe, jin mein Shogran, Neelam Valley, Murree aur Kaghan ke kuch hisse shamil hain.
Abiotic Profile (be-jaan mahol): Mitti: zarkhez, surmai-bhoori mitti jis mein organic maadda (humus, gale sare patton se bani khaad) zyada hai.
Climate (aab-o-hawa): Mo'tadil (moderate) darja hararat (4°C se 30°C); salana barish 750 mm se 1500 mm.
Key Flora (ahem paude): Taxus baccata (Yew), Pinus wallichiana (Blue Pine), Cedrus deodara (Himalayan Cedar, deodar), aur Berberis lyceum (Sumbal) jaisi jhaariyan.
Key Fauna (ahem janwar): Rhesus bandar (Macaca mulatta), kaala reechh (black bear), leopard cat, bheriye (wolves) aur kai qism ke parinde.
Current Status (maujooda haalat): Degraded (kharab ho chuka). Bohat se bare shikari janwar khatam ho chuke hain, aur jangal par lakri ki sanat (lumber industry) aur kheti ke phailao ka dabao hai.

blocks.alt: Barfeele pahar, bohat se conifer darakht, charagah aur nala. Labelled janwar: aage kala reechh (black bear), kaai wali chattan par rhesus bandar, chattan ki choti par leopard cat aur charagah mein bhediye.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.11: Temperate deciduous jangal aur us ke numainda paude aur janwar (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 25.11, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke ‘Key Flora’ mein diye gaye darakht (yew, blue pine, deodar) asal mein sada-bahar (evergreen) conifers hain jo sardi mein patte nahin girate. Pakistan ke in pahari jangalon mein in ke saath patjhar wale darakht bhi milte hain.

blocks.prompt: Temperate deciduous forest ka ek paudha aur ek janwar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan Taxus baccata (Yew) aur Rhesus bandar (Macaca mulatta).

items: Jagah: Shogran, Neelam Valley, Murree, Kaghan; mitti humus wali; 4°C-30°C, 750-1500 mm barish.
Paude: Yew, Blue Pine, Himalayan Cedar, Sumbal; janwar: rhesus bandar, kaala reechh, leopard cat, bheriye.
Haalat: degraded (shikari khatam; lakri aur kheti ka dabao).
